purpose: Persistent scientific memory for reconstructing not only mission state but the accumulated reasoning, conceptual dependencies, negative knowledge, capability lineage and unresolved frontier of the single continuous mission.
memory_principle: A future agent must inherit the reasoning structure of the mission, not merely its latest status.
authority: This memory is a structured reconstruction aid. Repository code, tests, CI, Git history and authoritative scientific documents remain higher-order evidence for current implementation claims.

identity.restart_rule: Never restart conceptually from zero when persistent mission memory is available; reconstruct, reconcile and continue.

knowledge_domains.ceutia: Evidence and epistemic layer: source -> document -> observation -> claim -> evidence -> corroboration/contradiction -> provenance -> confidence -> decision context.
knowledge_domains.serpiente: Dynamic mathematical/risk layer: state -> dynamics -> interaction -> prediction -> uncertainty -> risk -> warning.
knowledge_domains.integration: CeutIA establishes what is known, from where, when and with what epistemic status; SERPIENTE models dynamic states and risk conditional on admitted information and model assumptions.
knowledge_domains.boundary: Prediction, causal inference, intervention and operational effectiveness are distinct scientific claims.

concepts.definition: Legitimately available information at forecast origin t.
Point-in-time binding between a forecast and the information genuinely available at its origin.
Per-feature provenance including observation identity, source version, transformation lineage and availability.
Explicit separation of observation, event, publication, acquisition, availability and revision times plus physical elapsed time.
Outcome observation is itself a data-generating process with identity and temporal semantics.
Evaluation must use the scientifically appropriate independent unit rather than assuming row independence.
Historical, frozen, prospective and target-population baselines have different evidentiary roles.
association -> statistical dependence -> predictive dependence -> mechanistic hypothesis -> causal hypothesis -> causally supported -> intervention-supported -> operationally validated.
Uncertainty propagates from source and observation through state, interaction/model, forecast, risk and warning.
Distinguish changes in the world from changes in how a source measures, classifies, revises or publishes the world.
Relationships, lags, coupling strength, sign or topology may change while marginal variables remain stable.
A joint system configuration can be abnormal even when individual variables are individually normal.
Test whether A improves prediction of B beyond history(B) and already admitted covariates under temporal validation.
Detect transitions in generating regimes rather than treating all observations as exchangeable over time.
Separate descriptive propagation, predictive propagation, mechanistic hypotheses and causally supported propagation.
A warning is a traceable conditional signal carrying evidence, provenance, uncertainty, horizon and severity; it is not proof of future harm.
Prediction/warning -> decision -> eligibility -> intended mechanism -> action -> delay/exposure -> implementation failure -> outcome.
Value of information concerns how an additional measurement/source could reduce decision-relevant uncertainty under a specified decision problem; it is not feature importance.
WORLD, DATA, MODEL and SCIENTIFIC_VALIDITY are separately monitored because an anomaly in one plane need not mean an anomaly in another.
acquire -> verify -> version -> availability -> state -> trajectory -> anomaly/change -> interaction -> forecast -> uncertainty -> risk -> warning -> decision -> traceability.

discovery_relationships.reason: A forecast can only be scientifically tied to its legitimate information set when point-in-time availability is bound.
Future-derived information violates the forecast information boundary even if timestamps appear plausible.
A reconstructible information set permits forensic reconstruction of the exact admitted feature matrix where lineage is complete.
Feature provenance permits detection and attribution of source/version/latency/definition changes when source-process metadata exists.
Irregular sampling requires physical elapsed-time normalization rather than observation-index differencing.
A prediction cannot be evaluated correctly if outcome identity or timing is ambiguous or incomplete.
Ignoring repeated-forecast or process dependence can produce unjustifiably narrow uncertainty.
Historical performance cannot establish prospective target-population superiority without appropriate frozen or future data.
The system must not promote association into mechanism, causality or operational validity without the corresponding evidence.
Warning confidence depends on upstream source, measurement, state, model and forecast uncertainty.
Latency, denominator, schema or classification changes can mimic real-world trajectory changes.
A system may change through altered coupling even when individual marginals remain stable.
Risk may arise from a joint configuration or cascade rather than an isolated anomaly.
Complex interactions must demonstrate predictive value beyond simpler admitted histories and covariates.
A changed generating regime can invalidate historical behavioural assumptions without making the historical model itself incorrect.
Observed propagation does not establish causal propagation.
Prevention effectiveness requires linking warnings to decisions, actions, exposure and outcomes.
Without action and response data, a warning system cannot establish whether warnings changed outcomes.
World, data, model and scientific-validity failures require different diagnostics and interpretations.
A real-time capability cannot be claimed without verified acquisition behaviour and latency semantics.

decision_genealogy.decision: Keep CeutIA epistemically separate from SERPIENTE prediction.
decision_genealogy.basis: Prevents evidence/provenance claims from being silently upgraded into mathematical prediction or causality.
decision_genealogy.consequence: Cross-repo contracts must preserve the distinction.

decision_genealogy.decision: Treat PIT as a first-class scientific object.
decision_genealogy.basis: Forecast validity depends on what was actually knowable at forecast origin.
decision_genealogy.consequence: Feature-level availability, lineage and fingerprinting became required controls.

decision_genealogy.decision: Do not implement advanced mathematical families merely because they are sophisticated.
decision_genealogy.basis: Each method requires a concrete phenomenon, data-generating process, estimand, identifiability, assumptions, implementability and testability.
decision_genealogy.consequence: HMM/Kalman/particle/VAR/Hawkes/ODE/SDE/etc. remain candidates until justified by a registered target.

decision_genealogy.decision: Preserve negative evidence and failed workflows.
decision_genealogy.basis: A future agent must know which apparent evidence was actually negative and avoid repeating false conclusions.
decision_genealogy.consequence: The failed PIT workflow remains recorded as negative historical CI evidence.

decision_genealogy.decision: Do not close the continuous mission after finite audits.
decision_genealogy.basis: Audit closure proves bounded surfaces, not exhaustion of scientifically implementable capability.
decision_genealogy.consequence: Finite closure artifacts are explicitly bounded closures only.

decision_genealogy.decision: Do not equate external evidence requirements with stopping engineering.
decision_genealogy.basis: Many mechanisms can be implemented and prepared before prospective evidence exists.
decision_genealogy.consequence: NOT_ESTABLISHED and NOT_IMPLEMENTABLE remain separate statuses.

decision_genealogy.basis: Historical snapshots may contain stale branch, commit or mission-state labels.
decision_genealogy.consequence: Canonical state, reconciliation, Git/code/tests/CI and authoritative documents have explicit authority ordering.

negative_knowledge.statement: CI success is not scientific validation.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Using green workflows as evidence of real-world predictive truth.

negative_knowledge.statement: Historical fit is not prospective validity.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Claiming target-population future performance from retrospective fit alone.

negative_knowledge.statement: Multiple sources are not necessarily independent corroboration.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Counting dependent reproductions of one upstream source as independent evidence.

negative_knowledge.statement: Timestamp checks alone cannot prove absence of hidden upstream future-derived processing.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Treating declared timestamps as proof of complete production PIT lineage.

negative_knowledge.statement: Calibration is not validity or transportability.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Assuming calibrated historical probabilities remain calibrated after distribution shift.
Converting predictive dependence or Granger-type evidence into causal claims.
Claiming an alert prevents harm without response and outcome evidence.

negative_knowledge.statement: Correlation or association does not establish mechanism.
Generic anomaly scores are scientifically underdetermined without a target/reference distribution.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Implementing arbitrary anomaly scoring as if it were validated risk.
Ranking variables by predictive contribution when the question is decision-relevant information acquisition.

negative_knowledge.statement: Observation-order lag and physical-time lag are not interchangeable.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Using row counts as elapsed time under irregular sampling.

negative_knowledge.statement: Source disappearance or reporting latency can mimic a real decline.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Interpreting missing/late observations as immediate evidence of phenomenon change.

negative_knowledge.statement: Stable marginals do not imply stable interactions.
Correct individual predictions do not guarantee correct joint forecasts or joint calibration.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Assuming marginal performance proves multisystem correctness.

negative_knowledge.statement: Intervention can change the observation process as well as the phenomenon.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Interpreting post-intervention measurement changes automatically as causal outcome changes.

negative_knowledge.statement: Uncertainty artificially narrows when dependence is ignored.
negative_knowledge.avoid: Applying iid formulas to repeated or clustered forecasts without justification.

scenario_memory: apparently independent sources sharing one upstream source
model uncertainty correct conditional on wrong model class
retrospective evaluation not representative of prospective regime
correct individual predictions + wrong joint forecast
correct individual calibration + wrong joint calibration
documentary change point + no world change
intervention changes observation but not phenomenon
highly correlated variable + no incremental predictive value
true signal disappears under regime change
reconstruction_invariant: If a future agent cannot explain why a capability exists, what discovery led to it, what evidence supports its implementation status, what it does not prove, what dependencies remain, and what frontier it unlocks, the persistent memory is incomplete.
closure_rule: The mission remains open while a central, scientifically justified and reasonably implementable capability, validation preparation, integration, or knowledge extraction remains undiscovered or unresolved. External empirical limitations remain explicit rather than silently converted into closure.
